story.title: Truncate text to N words
story.goal: Cut a piece of text down to N words and add an ellipsis.
story.catch: Don't cut mid-word, and don't add an ellipsis when the text was already short enough. First attempts do both wrong — they slice characters and always append the '…'.
story.steering: Break on word boundaries; add the ellipsis only if you actually truncated.
story.why_it_matters: This is the bug behind every card preview that reads 'Fix WAL checkpoi…' or shows a stray ellipsis on a two-word title. It is small, visible to every user, and almost never caught by the happy-path test.
